title: Reuters Q3 revenue up 12% boosted by generative AI licensing
summary:
X author: @pressgazette

Reuters reported a 12% year-on-year increase in Q3 revenue to $232m, with generative AI licensing driving a 56% rise in news division transaction revenue to $44m. This reflects growing publisher compensation through AI content licensing deals.

Linked sources:
- https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/companies-markets/thomson-reuters-posts-higher-q3-revenue-lifts-2026-forecast

title: Cloudflare adds Personal Assistants traffic category with per-agent controls; Descope launches Envoy for Personal Agent Protocol
summary:
X author: @Zunbeamzero

Cloudflare shipped a new traffic category for Personal Assistants with per-agent Allow/Block options. Descope launched Envoy supporting Meta/Sierra's draft Personal Agent Protocol for scoped agent identities and permissions, with GoFundMe and GoodRx as partners.

Linked sources:
- https://www.cloudflare.com/

title: Anthropic signs first paid licensing deal with Associated Press
summary:
X author: @bayaiuai

Anthropic signed its first paid publisher licensing deal with the Associated Press for live attributed election data in Claude, ending its holdout on paid deals after publishers blocked its crawlers.

Linked sources:
- https://www.adweek.com/

title: Google analysis shows AI Mode queries run 3x longer but not visible in Ads search terms reports
summary:
X author: @sengineland

Search Engine Land reported on a new analysis of 400+ Google Ads accounts showing that Google’s claim of AI Mode queries running 3x longer is not reflected in search terms reports, with three possible explanations identified.
